Step: Create an operator AppUser and an interactive-user AppUser
Expected Result: Operator saved with AdAccount NULL, Initials NOT NULL, no Ignition role; interactive user saved with AdAccount and a role

Step: Inspect the stored attribution on the event
Expected Result: Event stamps a resolved AppUserId (never free-text initials or names); the record also carries the TerminalLocationId of the acting terminal, and system-triggered events are attributed to the system account

Step: Approach the terminal and perform a first action
Expected Result: UI prompts for initials; MES resolves the AppUser and establishes an operator presence context; no password is verified
New presence context replaces the prior one for subsequent events

Precondition: A terminal running a dedicated-flavor view
Expected Result: policy = confirm; initials persist across idle gaps subject only to the 30-minute re-confirmation

Precondition: A terminal running a shared-flavor view (e.g. Die Cast cabin)
Step: Return after idle or change the cell context
Expected Result: policy = strict; initials re-requested on first action after idle and re-prompted when the operator changes cell context

Step: Log into the Config Tool with AD credentials
Expected Result: Authenticates via Ignition's AD user source; operators do not exist in AD

Precondition: A mutation screen under an operator presence context
Expected Result: Initials field is pre-populated from the presence context; operator may override before submit

Step: Submit with unknown or deprecated initials
Expected Result: Submission blocked with a clear message via AppUser_GetByInitials; no auto-creation of users from unknown initials

Precondition: A terminal idle longer than 30 minutes
Expected Result: Re-confirmation overlay 'Operate as [XY]?' with [Yes] / [No — change]; Yes continues the context, No opens initials entry and clears the prior context
The 30-minute value is a Configuration Tool setting (not hard-coded) and takes effect

Precondition: A shop-floor terminal with operator presence
Step: Trigger an elevated action (e.g. place hold / scrap)
Expected Result: Elevation prompt accepts AD username+password; on success the action is stamped with the authenticating user's AppUserId, not the operator presence context
Each elevated action re-prompts for AD; there is no session-sticky (5-minute) elevation
Action does not execute; UI returns to the prior state

Precondition: AD groups mapped to Ignition roles
Step: Sign in as each interactive role
Expected Result: Quality / Supervisor / Engineering / Admin capabilities resolve per their AD group; Operator is the absence of interactive authentication
Shop-floor screens open on operator presence alone and expose no master-data functions; Config Tool / Supervisor / Engineering screens require AD auth on page entry

Precondition: A shop-floor screen with elevated action buttons
Step: View and activate an elevated control as an operator
Expected Result: Control is visible but triggers the FDS-04-007 AD prompt on activation; an unauthorised user cancels out

Step: Create an operator whose initials collide with an existing row
Expected Result: Admin enters disambiguating initials (unique); operator rows carry AdAccount NULL and no Ignition role
